name: Acadlix LMS – AI Quiz Maker, Online Exam & Course Plugin for WordPress
author: AcadLix

sections.description:
Acadlix LMS is a WordPress LMS, quiz, and online exam plugin for creating and selling online courses, mock tests, assessments, and complete eLearning websites. It combines course management, online examinations, assignments, live classes, built-in payments, AI-powered quiz creation, and a built-in PWA in one WordPress plugin.

It comes with a built-in AI Quiz Maker that helps you generate quizzes, questions, lessons, and course content using AI, and validate questions for accuracy and quality.

With its combination of LMS, online quiz, exam, and AI-powered content creation features, Progressive Web App (PWA) and mobile first design, Acadlix LMS is suitable for educators, coaching institutes, training centers, schools, colleges, and online course creators who want to build a feature rich eLearning platform on WordPress.

Whether you’re building an online academy, coaching institute, certification platform, employee training portal, or selling digital courses, Acadlix LMS gives you the tools to create engaging learning experiences from one dashboard.

Unlike other eLearning plugins for WordPress that require separate plugins or addons for LMS, quizzes, payments, subscriptions, live classes, and mobile app etc. Acadlix LMS keeps everything together in a single WordPress LMS Plugin, reducing setup complexity and ongoing maintenance.

👉 Acadlix LMS Pro

👉 Live Demo

👉 Documentation

👉 Support

See Acadlix in Action

Create Courses & Quizzes (Full Walkthrough)

AI Quiz Generator

AI Question Validation

Why Choose Acadlix

The Acadlix Free Version stands out by providing most of the essential features you need to build and run a complete eLearning website without requiring multiple plugins. You can create unlimited online courses, lessons, and quizzes, and sell your courses using built-in payment gateways such as PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and PayU.

Unlike many WordPress LMS plugins that restrict AI features to premium plans, Acadlix also includes AI-powered content creation in its free version, allowing you to generate quizzes, questions, lessons, and course content with AI. This makes Acadlix a powerful free LMS course and quiz plugin for WordPress, especially for educators, course creators, coaching institutes, and training organizations looking for a Learning Management System plugin for WordPress.

Whether you’re creating a small course website or managing a large examination portal, Acadlix helps simplify administration while providing students with a consistent learning experience.

Everything You Need in One eLearning Plugin for WordPress

✓ Create unlimited courses, lessons, quizzes, and exams

✓ Sell courses without WooCommerce

✓ Generate quiz questions with AI

✓ Validate existing questions using AI

✓ Conduct timed online examinations

✓ Run live classes

✓ Manage students and enrollments

✓ Track learning progress

✓ Accept online payments

✓ Drip Content and Announcements

✓ Course Pre-requisite

✓ App like student experience with Built-in PWA

Designed for Real eLearning Platforms

Acadlix LMS supports a wide range of educational use cases, including:

• Competitive examinations

• Mock test portals

• Professional certification

• Employee training

• Coaching institutes

• School assessments

• College learning portals

What You Can Build with Acadlix LMS on WordPress

Acadlix is designed for more than just online courses. Whether you’re teaching a single class or running a large learning platform, it provides the flexibility to support different teaching and business models.

Use Acadlix to build:

✓ Online Course Websites

✓ Competitive Exam Portals

✓ Mock Test Platforms

✓ Certification Programs

✓ Employee Training Systems

✓ School & College Learning Portals

✓ Coaching Institute Websites

✓ Paid Test Series

✓ Continuing Education Programs

✓ Skill Assessment Platforms

From structured learning paths to timed online examinations, Acadlix helps you deliver engaging learning experiences while managing students, payments, and progress from one dashboard.

AI Quiz Maker & AI-Powered Content Creation

Acadlix includes a built-in AI Quiz Maker for WordPress that helps educators and course creators generate quiz questions, validate existing questions, and create course, lesson, and quiz descriptions using AI.

Connect your own OpenAI API key to use AI features directly from your OpenAI account. Acadlix does not impose AI credits or monthly usage limits, so you pay only for your actual OpenAI API usage.

AI Features Included in the Free Version

✓ Generate quiz questions from a topic or prompt

✓ Validate existing questions for clarity and accuracy

✓ Create course descriptions

✓ Generate lesson descriptions

✓ Generate quiz descriptions

✓ Improve content writing speed

The AI Quiz Maker helps educators create and review quizzes faster while keeping control over the final content before publishing.

Why Use Your Own OpenAI API Key?

• No AI credits or monthly limits managed by Acadlix

• No separate AI subscription charged by Acadlix

• Pay only for your OpenAI API usage

• Full control through your own OpenAI account

This approach gives educators complete transparency over AI costs while allowing unlimited usage within their own OpenAI account limits.

Create Courses Without Coding

Acadlix includes a powerful WordPress course plugin that lets you create and organize online courses without writing code. Use the drag-and-drop course builder to structure your curriculum with sections, lessons, quizzes, assignments, downloadable resources, and multimedia content from a single interface.

Course Builder Features

✓ Unlimited courses, lessons, quizzes, and assignments

✓ Drag-and-drop curriculum builder

✓ Multi-level course structure and lesson ordering

✓ Course duration, difficulty levels, and learning outcomes

✓ Featured images and Rich text editor

✓ Instructor assignment and Course Announcements

✓ Logic-based Drip Content (Pro)

Rich Lesson Support

Create engaging lessons using multiple content formats:

• YouTube and Vimeo videos

• Self-hosted videos

• Audio, PDF, and image content

• Downloadable resources

• Text-based lessons

Students can follow structured learning paths while administrators manage courses, lessons, quizzes, resources, and other content from the WordPress dashboard.

Create Professional Online Exams

Acadlix LMS is a WordPress quiz and online exam plugin for creating timed exams, quizzes, practice tests, mock tests, and assessments. It supports use cases including competitive examinations, entrance tests, school and college assessments, certification programs, recruitment tests, and employee evaluations.

✓ Multiple attempts or attempt limits

✓ Question categories

Build Mock Tests and Assessments

Create competitive exams, entrance tests, mock test series, school and college examinations, professional certifications, employee evaluations, and practice quizzes with flexible assessment options.

Sell Courses Without WooCommerce

Acadlix LMS includes a built-in eCommerce and payment system that lets you sell online courses and test series directly from your WordPress website without installing WooCommerce or another separate eCommerce plugin. Manage course sales, student enrollments, payments, orders, and coupons within the same LMS.

Offline payments are also supported, allowing administrators to accept bank transfers, QR code payments, or other manual payment methods.

Manage Course Orders and Enrollments

Manage course purchases, student enrollments, payment history, and order details from the centralized WordPress dashboard, keeping course sales and learner management in one place.

Course Progress Tracking and Certificates

Acadlix LMS tracks course, lesson, and quiz progress, helping students monitor completed activities, resume learning, and view their overall progress from the student dashboard.

Learning & Student Progress Features

✓ Course completion tracking

✓ Lesson and Quiz progress

✓ Student dashboard

✓ Resume learning

Administrators can manage structured learning paths and monitor student progress and course completion. Certificates can be issued when learners complete the required course activities, making Acadlix suitable for online certification programs, training organizations, and continuing education.

Mobile-First & App-Like Learning Experience

Acadlix provides a responsive, mobile-first learning experience for accessing courses, quizzes, resources, results, and certificates across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Acadlix Pro adds an app-like mobile experience with built-in Progressive Web App (PWA) support, mobile login options, and a customizable bottom navigation menu for a more engaging mobile learning experience.

✓ Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile

Students can easily access enrolled courses, continue unfinished lessons, review quiz attempts, view results, and monitor their learning progress from a single dashboard across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Simplify Course Management

Managing an online learning platform involves more than publishing lessons. Acadlix provides tools that help administrators organize students, courses, and learning content from a central dashboard.

Administration Features

Whether you’re managing a few students or a growing learning platform, Acadlix helps reduce repetitive administrative work.

Live Classes with Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams (Pro)

Acadlix Pro supports live classes through Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and YouTube Live allowing educators to combine scheduled live sessions with self-paced online courses.

Live classes can be combined with video lessons, quizzes, assignments, and downloadable resources to create blended learning programs for coaching institutes, online academies, employee training, and instructor-led courses.

Built for Modern WordPress eLearning Websites

Acadlix is designed to integrate with modern WordPress websites while remaining easy to customize.

Integrated WordPress LMS for Easier Management

Acadlix LMS brings course management, quizzes, online exams, payments, student management, and learning features together in a single WordPress plugin. This integrated approach can reduce the need to combine multiple plugins for core LMS functionality and helps keep your learning platform easier to manage.

Fewer plugin dependencies often mean:

External Services

Acadlix connects to third-party services only when the corresponding feature is enabled and used by the site administrator or user.

OpenAI

Acadlix can connect to OpenAI when AI features are used. The site administrator provides their own OpenAI API key. Content submitted for AI generation or validation may be sent to OpenAI for processing.

OpenAI Terms of Use
OpenAI Privacy Policy

Stripe

Acadlix connects to Stripe when Stripe is enabled as a payment gateway. Payment, billing, order, and transaction information required to process payments may be sent to Stripe.

Stripe Terms of Service
Stripe Privacy Policy

PayPal

Acadlix connects to PayPal when PayPal is enabled as a payment gateway. Payment, billing, order, and transaction information required to process payments may be sent to PayPal.

PayPal User Agreement
PayPal Privacy Policy

Razorpay

Acadlix connects to Razorpay when Razorpay is enabled as a payment gateway. Payment, billing, order, and transaction information required to process payments may be sent to Razorpay.

Razorpay Terms
Razorpay Privacy Policy

PayU

Acadlix connects to PayU when PayU is enabled as a payment gateway. Payment, billing, order, and transaction information required to process payments may be sent to PayU.

PayU Terms
PayU Privacy Policy

Google reCAPTCHA

Acadlix uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 when enabled to protect forms and authentication endpoints from spam and abuse. Google may process information such as IP address, browser/device information, and interaction data.

Google Terms of Service
Google Privacy Policy

Support

For support or feature requests, please visit:

  • Plugin Support Forum
  • Acadlix Website

Credits

Developed by the Acadlix Team, creators of the modern and developer-friendly Acadlix LMS.

Build & Source Code

This plugin uses modern JavaScript (React, Webpack) and ships compiled assets
in the /build directory for performance reasons.

The original, human-readable source code is publicly available on GitHub:

Acadlix Free – GitHub Repository

Source files are located in:
– /src/

Compiled production files are generated into:
– /build/

Build Instructions

To reproduce the build files:

  1. Clone the repository
  2. Run npm install
  3. Run npm run build:free

This will generate the contents of the /build directory included in this plugin.

Documentation

For full usage instructions, setup guides, and advanced tips, visit the official documentation:

Acadlix Documentation
sections.installation:
Installing Acadlix LMS takes only a few minutes.

Install from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Acadlix LMS.
  3. Click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open Acadlix from the WordPress admin menu.
  6. Create your first course, quiz, or online exam.

Install Manually

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload it through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Start building your learning platform from the Acadlix menu.

Optional Setup

To unlock AI-assisted content generation:

• Create an OpenAI API key.

• Add your API key in Acadlix Settings.

• Start generating quiz questions and descriptions.

You can begin creating courses and quizzes immediately without configuring payment gateways or AI features.

Acadlix is built by a team with over 13 years of experience in EdTech and WordPress, focused on solving real challenges faced by educators, institutes, and course creators.
sections.faq:
What is Acadlix LMS?

Acadlix LMS is a WordPress LMS, quiz, and online exam plugin for creating and selling online courses, quizzes, mock tests, assessments, and eLearning websites.

Who is Acadlix designed for?

Acadlix is suitable for educators, coaching institutes, schools, colleges, corporate trainers, certification providers, and anyone who wants to build an online learning platform with courses, quizzes, and examinations.

Is Acadlix a free WordPress LMS plugin?

Yes. Acadlix core is available as Free that includes unlimited courses, lessons, quizzes, students, AI question generation, AI question validation, payments, certificates, and other essential LMS features.

Can I create unlimited courses?

Yes. The free version allows you to create unlimited courses, lessons, quizzes, and students.

Does Acadlix support AI-generated questions?

Yes. Connect your own OpenAI API key to generate quiz questions, validate existing questions, and create course or lesson descriptions. AI usage is billed directly by OpenAI based on your API consumption.

What question types does Acadlix support?

Acadlix supports Single Choice, Multiple Choice, True/False, Fill in the Blank, Sorting, and Matrix Matching question types. Acadlix Pro adds advanced question types such as numerical, numerical range, assessment, and essay.

Can I conduct timed online examinations?

Yes. You can create timed quizzes and examinations with automatic grading, negative marking, question randomization, passing scores, and detailed result reports. Acadlix Pro adds subject wise timing.

Can Acadlix be used for competitive and entrance exams?

Yes. Acadlix is designed to support competitive examinations, entrance tests, mock test series, and online test platforms. Acadlix Pro also includes dedicated competitive exam layouts for exams such as IBPS, JEE, GATE, UGC NET, NTA, CUET and state level competitive exams.

Does Acadlix support assignments?

Yes. Acadlix supports assignments as part of course learning activities. Acadlix Pro includes unlimited assignments, allowing instructors to combine assignments with lessons, quizzes, exams, and other course content.

Can I sell courses without WooCommerce?

Yes. Acadlix includes a built-in payment system for selling courses and test series without requiring WooCommerce.

Which payment gateways are supported?

Acadlix currently supports:

• Stripe

• PayPal

• Razorpay

• PayU

Offline payments are also supported. You can also integrate it with Knit Pay that supports more than 500 Payment gateways.

Does Acadlix support subscriptions?

Yes. Acadlix Pro supports subscription billing and multi-plan subscriptions for recurring course or learning-platform payments.

Can I issue certificates?

Yes. Certificates are available after learners complete course requirements. Additional certificate customization options are available in the Pro version.

Does Acadlix support live classes?

Yes. Acadlix Pro supports live classes through Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

Is Acadlix mobile friendly?

Yes. Acadlix is designed with a mobile-first approach. So it works seamlessly across different screen sizes and devices like Desktop, tablet, and Mobile.

Does Acadlix support a PWA and mobile learning?

Yes. Acadlix provides a responsive learning experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Acadlix Pro includes a built-in Progressive Web App (PWA), app-like mobile experience, mobile login options, and customizable mobile bottom navigation.

Does Acadlix work with Elementor?

Yes. Acadlix includes Elementor widgets that help you build custom course pages without coding.

Can I migrate from another WordPress LMS or Quiz Plugin?

Yes. Acadlix includes a migration tool to help move content from WP Pro Quiz, WP-ADV-Quiz, and LearnPress LMS.

Will Acadlix work with my WordPress theme?

Acadlix follows WordPress development standards and is designed to work with most modern themes. If you encounter compatibility issues, our support team can help.

Does Acadlix support drip content and course prerequisites?

Yes, Acadlix Pro supports the logical drip content and course prerequisites.

Do I need coding knowledge to run my eLearning Website on WordPress?

No. Courses, quizzes, exams, payments, and student management can all be managed from the WordPress dashboard without writing code.

Where can I find documentation?

Complete documentation, tutorials, and setup guides are available on the Acadlix website.

Where can I request new features?

Feature requests and feedback are always welcome. They help us improve Acadlix for educators and organizations around the world.

External Services

Acadlix connects to third-party services only when the corresponding feature is enabled and used by the site administrator or user.

OpenAI

Acadlix can connect to OpenAI when AI features are used. The site administrator provides their own OpenAI API key. Content submitted for AI generation or validation may be sent to OpenAI for processing.

Build & Source Code

This plugin uses modern JavaScript (React, Webpack) and ships compiled assets
in the /build directory for performance reasons.

The original, human-readable source code is publicly available on GitHub:

Acadlix Free – GitHub Repository

Source files are located in:
– /src/

Compiled production files are generated into:
– /build/

Build Instructions

To reproduce the build files:

  1. Clone the repository
  2. Run npm install
  3. Run npm run build:free

This will generate the contents of the /build directory included in this plugin.
